race.comment: Progressive filly BETTOR BEACH (1) has been impressive in winning in the first two rounds, coming from the back row and drawing clear late to score by 9.4m in last week's semi. Gets the ace draw here and should be able to take advantage of that having led from wider when easily winning in the heats prior. She can make it a clean sweep of the series. PRE EMINANT (9) hasn't been able to match BETTOR BEACH when runner-up in the first two rounds but it is worth noting they have been her only two runs off a lengthy spell and they should have improved her. May need luck from the back row but she won her only previous third-up attempt so expect she'll be peaking for finals night. KEAYANG PASSION (8) draws to trail BETTOR BEACH early and should be fit after placing in both starts off a spell. RACHELS LEGACY (4) improved to miss narrowly when second-up last week. Another that should be at her peak tonight. SWEET IRISH LOCH (5) draws wider but deserves respect off last week's fighting win.
